ns2:group.ns2:description:
China has unveiled a new generation of robotic “wolf pack” combat robots, according to CCTV.
The units include reconnaissance robots “Anying” (Shadow), strike robots “Yuxue” (Blooded), and support robots “Jidi” (Polar). They can carry weapons such as micro-missiles and grenade launchers.

ns2:group.ns2:description:
Insta360 said late Monday it has not received any court documents after reports that drone maker DJI filed a lawsuit in Shenzhen over six patent ownership disputes involving former employees.
In a statement, the company said the engineers joined after leaving DJI and that the patent applications were based on work developed independently during their time at Insta360.
The company also said the patents are not core technologies and are not expected to have a material impact on its operations, finances, or future development.
Insta360 added that withholding an inventor’s name in one filing was done in accordance with regulations, and that it will continue to monitor the case and disclose updates as required.

Try this next time you're prepping a project with multiple sources.
